channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Netanyahu promises Iran regime change: Can Israel topple Tehran government?
item.description: Israel can inflict devastating damage on Iran, but analysts question its ability to overthrow Tehran’s government.

item.title: Yemenis face severe shortages in Taiz amid Houthi blockade
item.description: Residents in Yemen’s Taiz are facing severe food and water shortages as a Houthi blockade cuts off a key supply route.

item.title: Iran reveals ‘offensive’ doctrine, US issues alert: Is war imminent?
item.description: US orders diplomatic staff out of Saudi Arabia amid escalating conflict and reports of potential US strikes on Iran.

item.title: At least four dead after storm brings flooding to southern France
item.description: The deaths include two women found drowned in a cellar in the Bouches-du-Rhône region.

item.title: Two killed in Houthi attack on airport in eastern Saudi Arabia, authorities say
item.description: It is the latest in a series of attacks by the Houthi movement targeting airports and other sites in the kingdom.

item.title: How do Israel's elections work and who are the main contenders?
item.description: Many view it as one of the most pivotal elections in Israel's history, with global implications.

item.title: Family of prison officer killed by IRA receives state apology
item.description: Brian Stack was crossing a street in Dublin in 1983 when he was shot in the back of the neck and died 18 months later.

item.title: How Arab parties could hold critical balance of power in Israeli election
item.description: Disaffection has often driven down turnout among Arab Israelis, but there is a strong push to get rid of the right-wing governing coalition.
